json.coverage_note: California Court of Appeal opinions are filed under ONE id, calctapp (177,473 opinions, 1839-2026), whatever the district or division. There are no division-level ids. The district ids hold only a small CourtListener import (calctapp1d 9 (2015-2016); calctapp2d 19 (2015-2016); calctapp3d 8 (2015-2016); calctapp4d 29 (2015-2016); calctapp5d 95 (2016-2019); calctapp6d 6 (2015-2016)); calctapp5d is the 2016-2019 Cal.App.5th import filed under the reporter SERIES, not the Fifth District. A filter on one district id misses almost every opinion of that district: use court="calctapp*" (calctapp + the district ids) and read the district from the docket number (get_case docket_number: A = 1st, B = 2nd, C = 3rd, D/E/G = 4th Div. 1/2/3, F = 5th, H = 6th District).
json.tip: Use the id value as the court parameter of search_cases. A trailing * matches prefixes: court="fla*" covers all Florida courts. Common ids: scotus, ca1..ca11, cadc, fla (FL Supreme), fladistctapp1..6 (FL DCAs), ga, gactapp.
